commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is booked.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Fabian Hurzeler is forced to make a change. James Milner is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).
89' James Milner (Brighton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
87' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt is neither hard nor precise, so Bart Verbruggen stops it easily.
86' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Keith Andrews decides to make a substitution. Kristoffer Ajer will be replaced by Romelle Donovan (Brentford).
79' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
79' The ball goes behind for a corner. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Diego Gomez.

76' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed just over the crossbar!
72' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
71' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
67' Keith Andrews has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) replacing Jordan Henderson.
65' The substitution has been made. Joel Veltman (Brighton) has replaced Mats Wieffer.

58' Pascal Gross (Brighton) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Caoimhin Kelleher has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

55' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post.
54' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton).
46' Keith Andrews has decided to substitute Keane Lewis-Potter and he is replaced by Kevin Schade (Brentford).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Keith Andrews gives a chance to Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) and Vitaly Janelt is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Diego Gomez (Brighton) is able to continue to play.
45+4' Looks like Diego Gomez (Brighton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

45+1' 0 - 2 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Danny Welbeck (Brighton) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:2.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Problems for Keith Andrews as Aaron Hickey is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) replaces him.
42' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
39' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
33' The corner kick picks out Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
33' The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
33' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and Brentford manage to earn a corner.
32' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Diego Gomez (Brighton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
30' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) tries his luck with a long-range shot, but the ball crashes against the bar. Great effort!
27' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
25' Igor Thiago (Brentford) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.

25' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Caoimhin Kelleher guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
24' James Milner (Brighton) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
23' It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
23' The ball possession at the moment is 29:71.
21' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

20' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him! The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
17' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

16' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Caoimhin Kelleher is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Brighton have a corner.
14' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
14' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Bart Verbruggen.
12' Brentford have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
12' This is a yellow card! Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
8' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
6' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to the feet of Lewis Dunk (Brighton), who directs his low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to block the effort.
6' Brighton will take a corner kick.

5' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee blows his whistle, Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
4' Pascal Gross (Brighton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Brentford will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
